usage: mrsm [actions] {options}

Create and Build Pipes with Meerschaum.

Actions options:
  action                Actions list to execute. E.g. `start api`
  -h, --help            Print a help message for an action.
  --loop                Loop the specified action forever (only for select
                        actions)
  -y, --yes             Agree to the default choices for prompts
  -f, --force           Override safety checks
  --noask, --no-ask     Automatically choose the defaults answers to
                        questions. Does not result in data loss.
  -A, --sub-args ...    Provide a list of arguments for subprocesses. You can
                        also type sub-arguments in [] instead. E.g. `stack
                        -A='--version'`, `ls [-lh]`, `echo -A these are sub-
                        arguments`

Jobs options:
  -d, --daemon          Run an action as a background daemon to create a job.
  --name, --job-name NAME
                        Assign a name to a job. If no name is provided, a
                        random name will be assigned.
  -s, --schedule, --cron SCHEDULE
                        Continue executing the action according to a schedule
                        (e.g. 'every 1 seconds'). Often used with `-d`. See
                        this page for scheduling syntax: https://red-engine.re
                        adthedocs.io/en/stable/condition_syntax/index.html
  --restart             Restart a job if not stopped manually.
  -e, --executor-keys EXECUTOR_KEYS
                        Execute jobs locally or remotely. Supported values are
                        'local', 'systemd', and 'api:{label}'.
  --rm                  Delete a job once it has finished executing.

Pipes options:
  -c, -C, --connector-keys CONNECTOR_KEYS [CONNECTOR_KEYS ...]
                        List of connector keys to search for. e.g. -c sql:main
                        api:main
  -m, -M, --metric-keys METRIC_KEYS [METRIC_KEYS ...]
                        List of metric keys to include in the search
  -l, -L, --location-keys LOCATION_KEYS [LOCATION_KEYS ...]
                        List of location keys to include in the search
  -i, -I, --mrsm-instance, --instance MRSM_INSTANCE
                        Connector Keys (type:label) to the Meerschaum instance
                        for Pipe objects. If label is omitted, use the
                        configured default interface (usually 'sql:main')
  -t, --tags TAGS [TAGS ...]
                        Only include pipes with these tags.
  --targets, --target TARGETS [TARGETS ...]
                        Filter pipes by targets. May be negated with `_`.
  --datetime-dtypes, --datetime-dtype, --dtype, --dtypes {datetime,int,None,_datetime,_int,_None} [{datetime,int,None,_datetime,_int,_None} ...]
                        Only select pipes with the corresponding datetime
                        dtypes (`datetime`, `int`, or `None`). May be negated
                        with `_`.
  --no-policy, --nopolicy
                        Leave the compression (columnstore) policy untouched.
                        With `compress pipes`, compress existing chunks now
                        without installing a policy; with `decompress pipes`,
                        decompress existing chunks now without removing the
                        policy (they will be recompressed on schedule).
                        TimescaleDB only.
  --full                When running `vacuum pipes`, run `VACUUM FULL` to
                        return freed space to the OS. Takes an exclusive lock.
                        PostgreSQL family only.

Sync options:
  --min-seconds, --cooldown MIN_SECONDS
                        The minimum number of seconds between syncing laps.
                        Defaults to 1.
  --timeout-seconds, --timeout TIMEOUT_SECONDS
                        The maximum number of seconds before cancelling a
                        pipe's syncing job. Defaults to 300.
  --listen              Keep the process alive after the initial sync pass so
                        subscription-style connectors (e.g. MQTT) continue
                        syncing via callbacks. Stops on `stop jobs` or CTRL-C.
  --unblock             Run the action asynchronously, if possible.
  --async               Run the action asynchronously, if possible. Alias for
                        --unblock
  --begin BEGIN         The begin datetime when syncing, fetching data.
  --end END             The end datetime when syncing, fetching data.
  --chunksize CHUNKSIZE
                        How many rows per chunk. Defaults to 100,000.
  --batchsize BATCHSIZE
                        How many chunks to process in parallel. Defaults to
                        number of CPUs.
  --chunk-minutes CHUNK_MINUTES
                        Specify the chunk interval in minutes for verification
                        syncs (and `partition pipes`). Defaults to 43200 (30
                        days).
  --chunk-hours CHUNK_HOURS
                        Specify the chunk interval in days for verification
                        syncs. See `--chunk-minutes`.
  --chunk-days CHUNK_DAYS
                        Specify the chunk interval in days for verification
                        syncs. See `--chunk-minutes`.
  --verify              Completely resync a pipe's entire interval.
  --deduplicate, --dedup
                        Remove duplicate rows from a pipe's table.
  --bounded, --bound    When verifying, do not sync outside the existing
                        oldest and newest datetime bounds.
  --skip-check-existing, --allow-duplicates
                        Skip checking for duplicate rows when syncing. This
                        improves performance when all rows to be synced are
                        unique.
  --skip-enforce-dtypes
                        Skip enforcing incoming data to a pipe's dtypes. This
                        improves performance when all rows are expected to
                        already be of the correct type.
  --skip-chunks-with-greater-rowcounts
                        When verifying, skip chunks with rowcounts greater
                        than the remote's.
  --check-rowcounts-only
                        Only compare row-counts when verifying pipes.
  --skip-hooks          Skip calling the sync hooks.
  --sync-data {nothing,backtrack,incremental,all,filter}
                        When copying pipes, specify what data to sync into
                        destination pipes. 'backtrack' uses the source pipe's
                        sync time; 'incremental' uses the destination pipe's
                        sync time (both apply the backtrack interval).
                        'filter' uses --begin, --end, and --params to restrict
                        the range. Defaults to 'nothing' (copy pipe
                        definitions only).
  --cache               Sync pipes' metadata to disk.

API options:
  -p, --port PORT       The port on which to run the Web API server
  --host HOST           The host address to bind to for the API server.
                        Defaults to '0.0.0.0'.
  --webterm-port WEBTERM_PORT
                        The port on which to run the webterm server.
  -w, --workers WORKERS
                        How many workers to run a concurrent action (e.g.
                        running the API or syncing pipes)
  --no-dash, --nodash   When starting the API, do not start the Web Console
                        dashboard.
  --no-webterm, --nowebterm
                        When starting the API, do not start the Webterm.
  --private, --private-mode
                        Require authentication for all endpoints.
  --secure              Start the API in secure mode, only allowing `admin`
                        users to execute actions.
  --no-auth, --noauth, --insecure
                        When starting the API, do not require authentication.
                        WARNING: This is dangerous!
  --production, --gunicorn
                        Start the API with the Gunicorn process manager.
  --keyfile KEYFILE     Start the API server with this keyfile (requires
                        --certfile).
  --certfile CERTFILE   Start the API server with this certfile (requires
                        --keyfile).

Plugins options:
  -r, --repository, --repo REPOSITORY
                        Meerschaum plugins repository to connect to. Specify
                        an API label (default: 'mrsm')

Tokens options:
  --ttl-days TTL_DAYS   For how many days should a token be valid.
  --scopes, --scope SCOPES [SCOPES ...]
                        Which scope permissions to grant to a token.

Packages options:
  --venv VENV           Choose which virtual environment to target when
                        installing or removing packages.

Compose options:
  --file, --compose-file FILE
                        Specify an alternate compose file (default: mrsm-
                        compose.yaml).
  --env-file ENV_FILE   Specify an alternate environment file (default: .env).
  --dry                 Update project pipes without syncing.
  --drop, -v, --volumes
                        Drop named pipes when running `mrsm compose down`.
  --presync             Run syncs before bringing up jobs.
  --no-jobs             Exit before starting background jobs.
  --isolated            Execute Compose commands in subprocesses.

Debugging options:
  --debug               Print debug statements (max verbosity)
  --trace               Trace execution and open browser windows to visualize
                        the stack.

Miscellaneous options:
  -V, --version         Print the Meerschaum version and exit. Has no effect
                        from within the shell.
  --patch               Patch parameters instead of overwriting.
  --nopretty            Print elements without 'pretty' formatting
  --rollback, --restore
                        When editing config, restore a key from its most
                        recent backup instead of editing.
  --skip-deps           Skip dependencies when installing plugins.
  --dry-run             Preview package installation without making changes.
  -P, --params PARAMS   Parameters dictionary in JSON format or simple format.
                        Simple format is for one-depth dictionaries and does
                        not need braces or quotes. JSON Example: --params
                        '{"meerschaum" : { "connectors" : "main" : { "host" :
                        "localhost" } } }' Simple example: --params
                        key1:value1,key2:value2
  --temporary, --temp   Skip creating or modifying instance tables when
                        working with pipes (plugins and users still trigger
                        table creation).
  --gui                 Open a DataFrame in an interactive pandasgui or
                        matplotlib window.
  --shell               Open the Meerschaum shell and execute the provided
                        action.
  --use-bash            Execute non-implemented actions via `bash -c`. Default
                        behavior is to execute directly.
  --allow-shell-job     Allow shell commands to be run as background jobs.
                        Default behavior is to only allow recognized actions.
  --no-daemon           Do not use the Meerschaum CLI daemon to execute the
                        action.
